go_oob_experiment.interpretation: Parent-path provenance and executable artifact identity are independent axes. The current parent gate is not evidence that the accepted launcher/guard code bytes are the bytes that ProductStart executes.

architecture_consequence.required_invariant: ProductStart must bind the pre-exec parent to an independently accepted executable admission-chain artifact identity, not merely to a root-owned non-writable path and basename.
